craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at theundeserved conqueror. Device: semicolon→comma (knowing stated softly, wanting released). Rejected: 'stringless' glossed as guitar pun — killed: never (vighna and smirk). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Stringless, yet the string-wise know thee, sole, triumphant, birth-free,
wantless, yet by kind the top prize of all wants.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirguṇo 'pi guṇajñānāṃ jñeya eko jayaty ajaḥ niṣkāmo 'pi prakṛtyā yaḥ kāmanānāṃ paraṃ phalam

reads_against.argmap: Qualityless even, of quality-knowers to-be-known, one conquers — unborn.; Desireless even, by nature: who is desires' supreme fruit. → The qualityless unborn conquers; the desireless is desire's fruit.
c1_essence: Qualityless one known of the knowing, desireless fruit of wants, conquers unborn.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
reads_against.l2: Qualityless even — of quality-knowers the to-be-known, one conquers, the unborn; desireless even, by nature — who is desires' supreme fruit.
l3: Stringless, yet the string-wise know thee — sole, triumphant, birth-free;
wantless, yet by kind the top prize of all wants.
reads_against.t1: One quality-less to-be-known even, the unborn conquers — desire-less by nature, the supreme fruit of desires.
